ruleset.name: Strand handler logging
ruleset.description: Checks handler failure logs for sensitive values.

rule.name: LOG-001
rule.message: Handler failure log format must not expose sensitive data.
rule.description: Checks the fixed warning message and request type.

rule.name: LOG-002
rule.message: Handler failure logs must use the sanitized throwable.
rule.description: Checks the sanitized throwable preserves stack and cause without messages.
